name: LottieFiles
summary: Library of 800,000+ free and premium Lottie animations plus browser tools to create, edit, test and ship motion.
description: Motion design platform around the Lottie and dotLottie vector animation formats: search free and premium animations by category and tag, create and edit animations in the browser, add no-code interactivity with state machines and light/dark theming, and implement them with runtimes and players for web, iOS, Android and React Native. Team workspaces add hosting, collaboration and developer handoff.
contains: browse by category (business, festive, health, finance, gaming, 404, ...) and tag (loading, success, ui, loop, ...)
Lottie Creator and Editor run in the browser; AI tools include Motion Copilot and prompt-to-vector
no-code state machines for clicks, hovers and data inputs, plus light/dark theming
runtimes and players for web, iOS, Android and React Native; plugins for After Effects, Figma, Webflow and Canva
hosting, embeds, asset management and team workspaces
600,000+ premium animations; Individual plan $19.99/mo billed annually
1,100+ animators available for hire; 16M+ users across 280,000+ companies
